1.w: The Proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a father glad, and a foolish son [is] the grief of his mother.

2.w: The treasures of wickedness will not bring gain, and righteousness delivers from death.

3.w: YHWH will not let the righteous soul go hungry, and the desire of the wicked ones He thrusts away.

4.w: The one making slack [his] hand becomes poor, and the hand of the diligent ones makes rich.

5.w: The one gathering in the summer [is] a wise son; one sleeping in the harvest [is] a son causing shame.

6.w: Blessings [are] on the head of the righteous, and the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

7.w: The memory of the righteous [is] for a blessing, and the name of the wicked will rot.

8.w: The one wise of heart receives commands, and the one foolish of lips will be thrown down.

9.w: The one walking in integrity walks securely, and the one twisting his ways will be known.

10.w: The one winking with the eye gives grief, and foolish lips will be thrown down.

11.w: A fountain of life [is] the mouth of a righteous one, and the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

12.w: Hatred stirs up strife, and love covers over all transgressions.

13.w: On the lips of a discerning one wisdom is found, and a rod [is] for the back of the one lacking understanding.

14.w: The wise treasure knowledge, and the mouth of the fool [is] near destruction.

15.w: The wealth of a rich one [is] the city of his strength; the destruction of the poor [is] their poverty.

16.w: The wage of the righteous [is] for life; the produce of the wicked [is] for sin.

17.w: The path to life the one guarding discipline, and one forsaking rebuke goes astray.

18.w: The one covering hatred [has] lips of falsehood, and the one bringing forth slander, he [is] a fool.

19.w: In the multitude of words sin is not lacking, and the one restraining his lips [is] wise.

20.w: The tongue of the righteous [is] choice silver; the heart of the wicked [is] for little.

21.w: The lips of the righteous feed many, and fools die by lack of heart.

22.w: The blessing of YHWH—it enriches, and toil cannot add to it.

23.w: The doing of evil [is] like laughter to a fool, and wisdom [is] unto a man of understanding.

24.w: The terror of a wicked one—it will come to him, and the desire of the righteous is given.

25.w: At the passing over of a whirlwind, a wicked one [is] no more, and a righteous one [has] a foundation forever.

26.w: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so [is] the sluggish one to those sending him.

27.w: The fear of YHWH adds days, and the years of the wicked will be short.

28.w: The hope of the righteous ones [is] joy, and the expectation of the wicked ones will perish.

29.w: The way of YHWH [is] strength for the upright, and destruction for doers of iniquity.

30.w: A righteous one will not be shaken forever, and the wicked will not dwell in the land.

31.w: The mouth of a righteous one brings forth wisdom, and a tongue of perversity will be cut out.

32.w: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing, and the mouth of the wicked ones, perversity.
